Represents configuration settings required for JWT authentication and token generation.

Remarks

This class is typically bound from application configuration (e.g., appsettings.json) and used to configure token issuance and validation.

Properties

AccessTokenExpirationInMinutes

Gets or sets the lifetime of the access token in minutes.

public required int AccessTokenExpirationInMinutes { get; set; }

Property Value

int

Remarks

Access tokens are short-lived and typically used for API authorization.

Audience

Gets or sets the intended audience of the JWT token.

public required string Audience { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

This value is validated during token verification.

Issuer

Gets or sets the expected issuer of the JWT token.

public required string Issuer { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

This value is validated during token verification.

RefreshTokenExpirationInDays

Gets or sets the lifetime of the refresh token in days.

public required int RefreshTokenExpirationInDays { get; set; }

Property Value

int

Remarks

Refresh tokens are long-lived and used to issue new access tokens without requiring the user to re-authenticate.

SecretKey

Gets or sets the secret key used to sign JWT tokens.

public required string SecretKey { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

This key must be sufficiently long and securely stored. It is used to create a symmetric security key for HMAC signing.
